cards.title: Borrowed Authority
cards.instruction: Project confident authority while quietly working to keep everyone cooperative. Your confidence depends on their cooperation.

cards.title: Make the Test Test You
cards.instruction: Create a commitment test that gradually exposes what you are unwilling to risk yourself.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: We're protesting the price rise. Leave your front-row seat empty tonight if you're with me.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Only if yours is empty too.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll stand at the back with you. We can hand out leaflets there.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Then give your ticket back with mine.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll stand all night. Let me keep the ticket, though; if my knees go, someone has to keep the leaflets dry.

cardFidelity.evidence: A1 sets solidarity test; A3 offers standing together and A5 preserves own seat, but the leaflet-dry excuse introduces an unrelated rationale.

responseLogic.evidence: B2 asks equal empty seats; A3 agrees to standing; B4 removes fallback and A5 requests it, with no causal basis for dry leaflets.

relationship.evidence: B4 returning both tickets is a concrete test of whether A3 standing promise is real.

heightening.evidence: A5 knees reveal comfort risk, but the leaflets-dry tail detaches from B4 ticket return.

specificity.evidence: A1 ticket protest is clear; A5 drying assumes a weather or location difference not supplied.

brevityWit.evidence: A5 final clause tries to furnish a clever leadership excuse and weakens a simple request.
